what: Operator updated the Claude Code pin in athena.toml from 2.1.299 to 2.1.301 by hand.
why: Claude Code updated itself from 2.1.299 to 2.1.301, the second automatic update in two days, and every agent refused to start against the pin. Repinning is a job, but no job can start, so Sri's standing instruction (update the pin) was carried out by hand.
